newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: D.Jones says Adelaide plans on schedule.
newsitem.headline: D.Jones says Adelaide plans on schedule.

text.p: Upmarket retailer David Jones Ltd said on Monday it still expected to close its John Martin's store in central Adelaide around February 1998 and had today lodged the first formal development for the proposed A$300 million Capital City project on the store's site.

In a statement, David Jones operations director Chris Walsh said discussions were continuing with potential investors and development participants in Australia and Southeast Asia for the project which includes a 250 suite luxury hotel and entertainment centre.
"We are on schedule and still expect the store to close around February next year," he said.

David Jones has announced plans to sell the store site in Adelaide's Rundle Mall on a vacant possession with development application basis, and today lodged its application to qualify for fast track approval processes under the South Australia government's major development status.

The company has named the Mirai Capital City Group which includes Tokyu's Pan Pacific Hotels group and Australian builder Baulderstone Hornibrook -- part of the Bilfinger and Berger Bau Ag -- as the project's development consortium.
